title: Co-op checks 2: arrows without popups, downed-pawn alert, calm camera, player markers (DPC 0.9.172-dev31, Camera Distance 2.9.17)
intro: Two controllers, both awake. A full party (Arisen, player 2's Archer pawn, at least one more pawn), out of combat, near a tall wall or cliff if you can. Playing the Arisen, co-op off. Each step lasts until you press End (keyboard).

settings.label: Give a played Archer missing special arrows
Crane: never look down more than (deg)
Calm: pull back / in at most (m/s)

probes.mode: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.cp and ((D.R.cp.on and D.R.cp.mode) or (D.coop.active and 'classic') or 'off')
probes.errs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.errors
probes.down: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and #D.R.down_list() or 0
probes.given: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.arrow_give.given or 0
probes.glast: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and tostring(D.R.arrow_give.last)
probes.arrows: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local im = sdk.get_managed_singleton('app.ItemManager'); local c = D and D.state.pawn_chara; if not (im and c) then return '' end; local s = ''; for _, id in ipairs({166, 167, 168, 169}) do s = s .. tostring(im:call('getHaveNum(System.Int32, app.Character)', id, c)) .. ' ' end; return s

steps.text: Get ready (see the intro). Press End.
PLAYER 1: press something on your controller. PLAYER 2: hold L3 + R3 until co-op starts (player 1 the Arisen, player 2 the Archer pawn).
ARROWS: player 2's Archer gets any missing special arrow, this time without an 'obtained' popup. PLAYER 2: try Incendiary, Nocuous and Deluging Shot once more; any popup? End when done.

DOWN ALERT: one of the other pawns is knocked down now. A red line at the top should name him, how far and which way, and count the seconds. PLAYER 1: go and revive him straight away (the line goes away). Don't leave him down: a pawn left down too long goes back to the Rift. End when done.

expect.label: the alert listed a downed pawn

steps.text: CALM CAMERA + CRANE: run both players along a tall wall or cliff, then have one sprint away. The camera should move smoothly, never lurch; a player who outruns it gets an edge marker. Sliders: REFramework menu > Camera Distance > Couch co-op > Calm camera. End when done.
MARKERS: player 1 runs off screen: gold marker; player 2 off screen: light blue marker. End when done.
Done. PLAYER 1: hold L3 + R3 for 3 seconds to end co-op. Tell Claude: arrows (fired? message?), the alert, the crane, the gold marker.
